Ranks Montgomery tracts by CDC adult asthma prevalence per adult and left-joins the 2026 code-violation count per tract, preserving null health values and placing geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH cdc AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_rate_per_adult,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS adult_population
  FROM session.fw_35996b_m1_cdc
),
violations AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    n AS code_violations_2026
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_35996b'
    AND source = 'm2_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT
  t.name AS tract_name,
  c.adult_asthma_rate_per_adult,
  c.adult_population,
  COALESCE(v.code_violations_2026, 0) AS code_violations_2026,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
LEFT JOIN cdc AS c ON c.geoid = t.geoid
LEFT JOIN violations AS v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
ORDER BY adult_asthma_rate_per_adult DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
